title: Korean Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with tender lamb and steamed vegetables.
instructions: Season the lamb with Korean chili flakes and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until reached a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Cook the quietly rice according to package instructions.
Steam the cucumber slices for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Assemble the wrap by placing a portion of the cooked lamb, rice, and cucumber onto each wrap.
